title: GIM: Global Integrated Model

creators.name: Osiptsov, Andrei A.
creators.affiliation: JSC Sberbank of Russia; Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology (Skoltech)

description: A year-by-year deterministic simulation of the world as 57 interacting country agents: economy and prices, climate and carbon cycle, natural resources, society and politics, interstate relations, and discrete crises with stock-flow-consistent finance. Includes history-matched ensembles, weak-signal detection, stability analysis (Jacobian spectral radius, twin runs, 30-year fans), and a game-mechanical scenario layer.
